in_tamil.name: பிரதப்

in_marathi.name: Pratap
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pratap हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'pratapana', which means to 'shatter' or 'dazzle'. It is a name that represents courage, bravery, and valor. It is a name for a king or a warrior, someone who is shining and dazzling in the battlefield.
